questions.q: In ΔABC, D is a point on AC such that AB = BD = DC, if ∠BAD = 70°, then the measure of ∠B is:
questions.solution:
Given, AB = BD = DC

And ∠BAD = 70°

In ΔABD,

⇒ ∠BAD = ∠BDA = 70° [∵ AB = BD]

⇒ ∠ABD + ∠BAD + ∠BDA = 180°

⇒ ∠ABD = 180° – 70° – 70° = 40°

⇒ ∠BDC = 180° – ∠BDA = 180° – 70° = 110°

In ΔBDC,

⇒ ∠DBC = ∠DCB [∵ BD = DC]

⇒ ∠DBC + ∠BDC + ∠DCB = 180°

⇒ 2∠DBC = 180° – 110° = 70°

⇒ ∠DBC = 35°

⇒ ∠ABC = ∠ABD + ∠DBC = 40° + 35° = 75°

questions.q: In a circle with center O and radius 10 cm, PQ and RS are two parallel chords of lengths x cm and 12 cm, respectively, and both the chords are on the opposite side of O. If the distance between PQ and RS is 14 cm, the value of x is:

By using Pythagoras Theorem

⇒ (OR)² = (ON)² + (RN)²

⇒ 10² = (ON)² + 6²

⇒ ON = 8 cm

⇒ NM = 14 cm

⇒ OM = NM – ON = 14 – 8 = 6 cm

In ΔPMO

By using Pythagoras Theorem

⇒ (OP)² = (OM)² + (MP)²

⇒ 10² = (6)² + (x/2)² [∵ PQ = x cm, ∴ MP = x/2 cm]

⇒ x/2 = 8

⇒ x = 16 cm

questions.solution:
a + b + c = 2, a² + b² + c² = 26

AS we know,

⇒ 2² = 26 + 2(ab + bc + ca)

⇒ ab + bc + ca = -11

⇒ a³ + b³ + c³ – 3abc = (a + b + c) [(a + b + c)² – 3(ab + bc + ca)]

⇒ 2[2² – 3 × (-11)]

⇒ 2[4 + 33]

⇒ 74

questions.q: The average of eleven numbers is 54. The average of the first four numbers is 48 and that of the next four numbers is 25% more than the average of the first four. The ninth number is 8 greater than the 11thnumber and the tenth number is 4 greater than the 11th number. What is the average of the 9th and the 10thnumbers?
questions.solution:
Average of 11 numbers = 54

Sum of 11 numbers = 54 × 11 = 594

Average of the first four numbers = 48

Sum of the first four number = 48 × 4 = 192

Average of the next four numbers = 48 × [5/4] = 60

Sum of the next four numbers = 60 × 4 = 240

Let the 11th number be x.

∴ 9th number be x + 8 & 10th number be x + 4

Sum of 9th, 10th and 11th numbers = 594 – 192 – 240 = 162

According to the question

⇒ x + 8 + x + 4 + x = 162

⇒ 3x = 162 – 12

⇒ x = 50

⇒ 9th number = x + 8 = 50 + 8 = 58

⇒ 10th number = x + 4 = 50 + 4 = 54

∴ Average of 9th and 10th number = (58 + 54)/2 = 56

questions.q: Some fruits are bought at a rate of 11 for Rs. 100 and an equal number at a rate of 9 for Rs. 100. If all the fruits are sold at a rate of 10 for Rs. 100, then what is the gain or loss percent in the entire transaction?
questions.solution:
Suppose 99 fruits are bought at a rate of 11 for Rs 100, then cost of 99 fruits = 9 × 100 = Rs. 900

99 fruits are also bought at a rate of 9 for Rs 100, then cost of 99 fruits = 11 × 100 = Rs 1100

Total cost of 198 fruits = 900 + 1100 = Rs. 2000

SP of 10 fruits = Rs. 100

SP of 1 fruit = Rs. 10

SP of 198 fruits = Rs. 1980

⇒ Total loss = 2000 – 1980 = Rs. 20

∴ Required loss percentage = [20/2000] × 100 = 1%

questions.q: Sudha saves 15% of her income. If her expenditure increases by 20% and savings increase by 60%, then by what percent has her income increased?
questions.solution:
Let income of Sudha be 200x

Saving of Sudha = 200x × [15/100] = 30x

Expenditure of Sudha = 200x – 30x = 170x

New Expenditure of Sudha = 170x × [6/5] = 204x

New Savings of Sudha = 30x × [8/5] = 48x

New income of Sudha = 204x + 48x = 252x

New income increased by = 252x – 200x = 52x

∴ Required percentage = [52x/200x] × 100 = 26%

questions.q: To do a certain work, the ratio of the efficiencies of A, B and C is 7 : 5 : 6. Working together, they can complete the same work in 35 days. B and C work together for 21 days. The remaining work will be completed by A alone in:
questions.solution:
Efficiency ratio of A, B and C = 7 : 5 : 6

Total work = (7 + 5 + 6) × 35 = 18 × 35 = 630

Completed work by B and C in 21 days = (5 + 6) × 21 = 231

⇒ Remaining work = 630 – 231 = 399

questions.q:
Select the correct active form of the given sentence.

The injured were being moved to the hospital by the police.
options: The injured was moving the police to the hospital.
The police has been moving the injured to the hospital.
The police moved the injured to the hospital.
The police were moving the injured to the hospital.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 4.

Key Points

• In the given question, 'were being moved' is used which indicates that the active voice of the sentence will be in past continuous tense because if a sentence is in past continuous tense, we add 'being' and use the past participle form (v3) of the verb.

• So, in order to convert it to active voice, we first interchange the subject and object i.e. 'the injured' and ' the police'.

• Then, we use the past continuous tense i.e 'were moving'.

• So, the correct sentence will be- *'' The police were moving the injured to the hospital.''*

• Police is a noun which describes a collection of police officers and therefore cannot be singular. So the verb coming after the plural noun police should always be plural.

Thus the only correct answer option 4.

Options 1,2 and 3 are incorrect.

After A, it should be C i.e '' *The ship broke down in rough seas and high-speed winds caused it to rock heavily from side to side.*'' This is because it gives the reason as to why the holiday turned into a dangerous experience.

Options 1,2 and 3 is incorrect.
